title: canary-release-pinning-notes-sam-rosen
content:
Purpose:
Quick personal scratchpad for pinning strategy and checklist for the upcoming canary (v2.14.0 -> v2.15.0). Mostly notes to self + TODOs. Not final - will move items into the release checklist doc when stable.

Context:
- Target rollout: canary on Hosted API for model-routing service + serving-runtime change (kv cache fix).
- Goal: 1% traffic canary -> validate latency, error budget, output quality (regressions).
- Why pin? Need stable baseline for rollback and A/B comparisons; avoid auto-upgrades that mix variants.

Pinning strategy (high-level):
- Pin deployment image tag and model bundle id simultaneously. Don't rely on floating tags.
- For hosted: use route-level config to pin customers in canary cohort to model v2.15.0-pin1 and runtime image 2024-11-14-kerneled.
- For Dedicated/private: document recommended migration commands and a note that customers may require manual coordination.

Checklist (initial):
- [ ] Create canary cohort (1%): hash-based routing rule (user_id % 100 < 1) - verify traffic distribution in staging.
- [ ] Bake image/tag: pushing runtime image with explicit sha (sha256:abcd...).
- [ ] Upload model bundle and record bundle id (bundle-2024-11-14-rc3).
- [ ] Update route config: set model_bundle_id & runtime_image_sha in canary route.
- [ ] Lock autoscaling min to current baseline to avoid noisy scaling during measurement.
- [ ] Start canary at 09:00 PST, monitor first 30m closely for 5xx spikes and latency P95.
- [ ] Run quality evals: prompt-set A (prod-sanity), metric: pass-rate >= 98% vs control.
- [ ] If anomalies: immediate rollback to previous pinned bundle and image, notify on-call and ENG release leads.

Metrics to watch (primary):
- 5xx rate (per-route)
- latency P50/P95/P99 (tokens/sec & ms)
- model output quality: prompt-set eval pass rate, hallucination rate (manual sampling)
- cost-per-token deltas (regression check)

Rollback playbook (quick):
- If 5xx > 0.5% sustained 10m OR any user-facing regression flagged by CS: revert route to previous model_bundle_id + runtime_image_sha, scale down canary to 0% via routing flag, open incident in JIRA-REL-789, ping #releases and on-call.
- Document exact revert commands here:
  - hosted: redwoodctl routes update --route model-routing-canary --model-bundle bundle-2024-11-13-stable --runtime-sha sha256:1234
  - confirm traffic change and check logs for errors

Pinning edge cases / open questions:
- Can we pin model bundle but keep runtime image floating for quick hotfixes? risk: behavioral mismatch; prefer to pin both.
- How to handle feature flags tied to runtime build-date (metrics/log format changes) - add gating in rollout checklist.
- Need to verify canary logging trace ids map across pin changes for A/B analysis.

Next steps / TODOs:
- [ ] Confirm bundle id once Maya finishes final eval (Maya -> update here).
- [ ] Add exact SHA when image build completes (CI job: ci/build-runtime#542).
- [ ] Draft short customer-facing note for Dedicated users if rollout changes expected.
- [ ] Sync with SRE (Noah) about autoscaler limit implications and rollback latency.

Quick notes to self (scratch):
- Keep canary small but long enough (~24h) for subtle regressions. 1% might not catch rare faults - consider 5% for runtime-only changes if safe.
- Capture a snapshot of traffic traces for canary and control for offline eval.
- Remember to snapshot route config and save in Confluence page CONFLUENCE-RELEASE-1234 under /release-assets/canary-configs.

Conversation snippets to copy into release doc later:
- "If we see any transitive increase in P99, revert immediately; small cost increase acceptable but not increased error surface." - Olivia
- "Prefer pinning both model and runtime - mixed versions are the hardest to debug." - Noah

End of scratchpad.
(Will convert to formal checklist once bundle and sha are final.)
